title.description: The story's title, e.g. 'The soldier who fought for 29 years after the war ended'

category.description: Today's category id, exactly as given

hook.description: The first line's idea in a few words

headline.description: The big two-line card on the first frame, like a thumbnail: top sets it up, bottom is the punch. Capitals.

summary.description: One sentence: who, what, the twist

music.description: tension for war, mystery, disaster, survival; bed for lighter stories

sources.description: Reliable sources (encyclopedia, museum, major newspaper, primary record) with the key facts each confirms

text.description: What the narrator says for this cut. Numbers written as spoken words.

caps.description: Captions: chunks of 1-4 words split by |, exactly one *word per chunk is the red key word. Digits allowed here, e.g. 'In *1944, | a young *officer'

image.description: The real picture for this line. Omit it to keep the previous picture on screen.

wiki.description: The exact title of the English Wikipedia article whose main picture shows this line: the person, ship, battle, building, place or object itself

search.description: Only when no single article fits: a precise Wikimedia Commons search, the way a museum caption names it

caption.description: 2-3 short lines: a curiosity line, a question that invites comments, and 'Follow for a new untold story every day.' No hashtags here.

youtubeTitle.description: The hook as a title, ending with #shorts

photos.description: Filled in by the pipeline, never by the writer
